message.content: Thane Chambers expresses a strong interest in stealth mechanics, particularly stealth boosts, indicating that he believes they could significantly enhance the gaming experience. In a conversation with Li Hua, Thane Chambers enthusiastically suggests that stealth boosts would add a new layer of strategy and excitement to gameplay. He highlights how stealth mechanics can provide players with different ways to approach situations, which he views as refreshing and could lead to "epic moments with strategies and surprises." This suggests that Thane Chambers sees stealth boosts as a valuable addition to the game, contributing to a richer and more varied gaming experience.
